prompt: A toy boat travels across a pond at a constant velocity of +2.4 m s^-1 for a time of 15 s. Using graph area principles, calculate the displacement of the boat.
hints: Constant velocity forms a rectangle on a velocity-time graph.
solution: The velocity-time graph is a horizontal line forming a rectangle. Displacement = height x width = (+2.4 m s^-1) x (15 s) = +36 m.
teacher_walkthrough: Step 1: Identify that constant velocity produces a horizontal line.
Step 2: The region under the line between t = 0 and t = 15 s is a rectangle.
Step 3: Area = 2.4 m s^-1 x 15 s = 36 m.
Step 4: Forward motion gives displacement = +36 m.
